title: The space of Delzant polytopes is an absolute retract

comparators.scope: Sixteen original required contracts: AE/AR, extension, refinement, metric equivalence, example, approximation and homotopy density.
Forty-three additional exact source contracts, including both literal source metrics, full Example 2.4 and quantitative Appendix A.
Nine overlapping proved core contracts; this suite does not add independent coverage.
The actual planar Minkowski counterexample and determinant obstruction.

main_results.scope: Absolute extensor and retract properties for Delzant polytopes in the exact Euclidean Hausdorff metric, including open convex support restrictions and controlled extensions.
The corresponding result in the Lebesgue symmetric-difference metric, with a proved identity homeomorphism between the two metric topologies.
Smooth projective refinement of rational polytopal normal fans.
The concrete triangle counterexample, five-ray sum, hexagonal refinement and prism perturbation with exact Euclidean Hausdorff error 3t.
Continuous approximation with arbitrary continuous positive error and locally finite normal fans.
A jointly continuous deformation equal to the identity at time zero, with Delzant values and Hausdorff error less than t for 0 < t ≤ 1.
Quantitative filling of actual loops in the closed complex disk, using compatible covers; the particular annular triangulation is not constructed.
